description:
Deploy a strategy as a trading bot. Defaults to paper trading for safety — whether a bot trades real money is determined entirely by the exchange account it's attached to (not by the `live` flag alone), so this refuses to deploy if `live` doesn't match the target exchange's own paper/live status. Check an exchange's status with list_exchanges first, or create one with create_paper_exchange. The bot trades on the strategy's own timeframe unless you pass `timeframe`; omit `name` and the server names it.

The bot STARTS TRADING when it is created, so give it its settings here, not in a later update_bot: `presetId` (a bot preset's ID or slug, e.g. "smart-accumulator-smart-dca": its parameters, timeframe, execution mode and version; it must belong to `strategyId`), `parameterOverrides` and `executionMode`. They are applied by the server in the same create, so the bot's first run already uses them and every plan, same-coin and history check runs on the final settings. With a preset the bot is created paused and then started, so it never runs without the preset; a start the server refuses (e.g. another bot already trades that coin on the account) leaves it paused and the reply says why. Pass `start: false` to create it paused (start it later with start_bot).

exchangeId.description: Exchange account ID. Its own isPaper status (see list_exchanges) determines whether this bot trades real money — must match the `live` flag below.

executionMode.description: "on_bar_close" (what backtests simulate) or "continuous". Omit for the preset's, else the server default.

live.description: Must match the target exchange's own paper/live status: false requires a paper exchange, true requires a live one. Defaults to false (paper) for safety.

market.description: Market type. Omit to use the account default (spot).

name.description: Bot name. Omit to let the server name it.

parameterOverrides.description: Strategy parameters, e.g. {"BUY_AMOUNT": 50}. With presetId they go on top of the preset's, and a null removes one of the preset's so the strategy default runs.

positionSizePercent.description: Position size as a percentage of account balance per trade. Defaults to 10%.

presetId.description: Apply this bot preset at creation: its ID or slug (e.g. "trade-wind-long-only"), a preset of `strategyId`. Its parameters, timeframe, execution mode and version, with parameterOverrides / executionMode / timeframe on top. Never changes size or leverage.

start.description: true (default): the bot starts trading once created. false: it is created paused; start it with start_bot.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe the bot trades on (e.g. 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d). Omit to use the strategy's (or the preset's) own timeframe; only set it to override that. Your plan may limit which timeframes are allowed.

name: deploy_bot
